# Learned instinct: pci-pan-unreadable-at-rest (confidence 1)

PAN (Primary Account Number) must be unreadable wherever stored. Acceptable methods: one-way hashing (SHA-256+ of entire PAN), truncation, index tokens with secured pads, or strong cryptography. Storing full PAN in plaintext is a CRITICAL violation. Any Ansible task writing to a data store that might contain PAN must ensure the destination is encrypted.

Source: PCI DSS v4.0.1 Req 3.4.1 — render PAN unreadable
